crossRefs.note: He who doesn’t take his cross and follow after me, isn’t worthy of me.

For whoever wants to save his life will lose it; and whoever will lose his life for my sake and the sake of the Good…
He said to all, “If anyone desires to come after me, let him deny himself, take up his cross, and follow me.
“If anyone comes to me, and doesn’t disregard his own father, mother, wife, children, brothers, and sisters, yes, and…
Whoever doesn’t bear his own cross, and come after me, can’t be my disciple.
